scope: Read-only diagnosis against the actual locally served five-episode build

reproduction.originalFailure: fettarme gegriffen qxvkjzqvjkqzvq expected 2/3 coverage for UFO537 Festival, received 3/3
reproduction.minimized: Native pagefind.createInstance(...).search(term), before any result.data() or application worker; raw word positions copied immediately
reproduction.orderIndependence: qxvkjzqvjkqzvq alone and after fettarme, gegriffen returned the same UFO537 identity and raw position 12283

quotedSingleTermGermanFormObservations.limitation: Both empty in quoted mode on this real corpus. Unquoted searches match compounds such as Fußball and Fussel; this is not a positive proof of foot inflection behavior.

quotedModeLimitation: On this index quoted single terms expose only the first matched raw word position per episode. For fettarm/fettarme unquoted positions were 6439,6451,6454,6531; quoted mode returned only 6439. Blindly quoting all terms would lose later coarse segment Fundstellen.
conclusion: The artificial Latin nonce was an invalid no-hit assumption: native Pagefind partial-word matching maps it to shorter indexed components. No application state or result collision is needed to reproduce it. Coverage describes native search-term matching, not exact lemma counts.
decision: Keep production native partial matching and German stemming unchanged. Use the preflighted Greek no-hit control for technical 2/3 coverage QA, and document that partial matching may overmatch initials/compound components. A future stricter matching policy would be a separate behavior decision.
